claims.note: Tours read at origin/feat/tours-6-11 (PR 18). The fact is true, but the cited section is wrong. 'What happens during a garbage collection' lists phases (mark, relocate, compact) and says the compacting phase 'moves objects that have survived'. The words 'memory-copying function to compact the reachable objects in memory' are under 'Memory release'. Learn also says compaction happens only when a collection finds a significant number of unreachable objects, and that large objects are usually not compacted. Fix: cite 'Memory release' for the copy sentence and 'What happens during a garbage collection' for the compacting phase. Add 'can' if the text says every collection copies.
claims.checkedAgainst: Microsoft Learn, Fundamentals of garbage collection (page fetched this session; primary vendor documentation)
